name: Petlings: Merge & Battle
summary:
A pet merge game with team battles. Players hatch pets on a farm, merge two of a kind into the next tier, or mix two different pets to discover new ones, filling a collection organized into habitat sets. Coins earned on the farm, even while away, pay for faster hatching, a bigger coop and luckier eggs.

Pets can then be sent into battle across 20 worlds and 500 story stages full of enemies and bosses. Pets fight on their own while the player triggers their special moves as they charge, with weapons forged and upgraded in an Armory. Friends can visit each other's farms, send daily gifts and race on a weekly leaderboard.
